metadata.scope: Official Halifax Regional Municipality annual audited consolidated financial statements used to extend the established conservative statement/schedule extraction to a contiguous 2019–2025 source-year series. The official 2018 Council attachment is retained as a documented parser gap rather than being forced into released data.
metadata.note: Comparative prior-year values printed in each annual statement remain source-presented comparators. The 2019 statement provides source-presented 2018 comparatives, but HalifaxData does not relabel those comparators as a successfully parsed 2018 source.
